## The FinOps cleanup that never sticks

[![Watch: The FinOps cleanup that never sticks](img/tutorials/finops-cleanup.png)](https://youtu.be/1ToeGihqaAI)

Find orphaned Azure resources with built-in cost rules: run a scan, read the findings, export a CSV, and never rebuild the list.
